files.description: NextGen Enterprise EHR EHI Data Dictionary — 10,875-page PDF containing SQL Server table/column schema for 5,290 tables and 283,279 columns. Lists table names, column names, data types, defaults, and not-null constraints. Dated June 27, 2025.

HTML source of the EHI Data Dictionary Hyperlinks landing page. Contains explanatory text about the EHI export format and links to data dictionaries for NextGen Enterprise EHR, Office, Direct Messaging, and Mirth Connect.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI landing page rendered in Chrome browser.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts structured table/column data from the PDF via pdftotext. Run with: bun run extract-data-dictionary.ts
Extracted data dictionary as JSON array: 5,290 table objects each with table name and columns array (name, dataType, default, notNull). Machine-queryable version of the PDF.
Extraction statistics: table count, column count, data type coverage, sample tables, and known parsing limitations.
Intermediate pdftotext plain-text extraction of the PDF, used as input to the enrichment script.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output files, and known parsing limitations.
